objective.text: Add a freshness and replay policy to an authentic webhook instead of treating a valid signature as proof of a new delivery.

difficulty.rationale: Separate message authenticity from evidence that processing it is fresh and permitted.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

assumptions: The provider signs the timestamp, delivery ID and body. It defines a five-minute acceptance window and a unique delivery ID. The application can store consumed IDs durably.

stem: An attacker replays an old authentic delivery unchanged. Which acceptance policy adds the missing replay protection?

options.text: Check only that the unsigned request arrival time is recent.
options.rationale: Every replay arrives now; that says nothing about when the provider signed the message.
options.misconception: Every replay arrives now; that says nothing about when the provider signed the message.

options.text: Accept repeated IDs whenever the body is byte-for-byte identical.
options.rationale: That explicitly permits the unchanged replay the requirement excludes.
options.misconception: That explicitly permits the unchanged replay the requirement excludes.

options.text: Verify the signature, enforce the signed time window, and reject an already consumed delivery ID.
options.rationale: Signature validity alone survives replay; freshness and consumed-identity checks add the required temporal and replay boundary.

options.text: Verify only the signature because authentic bytes cannot be replayed.
options.rationale: A captured authentic message can retain its valid signature when resent unchanged.
options.misconception: A captured authentic message can retain its valid signature when resent unchanged.

explanation.summary: Signature validity alone survives replay; freshness and consumed-identity checks add the required temporal and replay boundary.
